qualification: Initial synthetic controls, independently exported by Microsoft Word. Thirteen real HTTP conversions on A4/Letter and standard/PDF-A-1b/2b/3b matched Word text, pages and 39 anchors (maximum 0.10 pt difference). Representative exact-leading overlap was visually reviewed against Word. The combined normal build passes 1833 JVM tests with no failures, errors or skips. Existing golden images were not replaced.
